children: TD Cowen reiterated their Buy rating on SpaceX's stock with a price target of $200.00.
The price target implies an upside of 24.6% from the Oct 8 close of $160.57.
Key takeaways from the analyst note
Strong Growth Prospects in AI Segment

: SpaceX's AI segment, driven by its AI Compute leasing and Grok subscriptions, is expected to see significant revenue growth, rising from $19.4 billion in 2026 to $155.1 billion by 2028, with a remarkable 79% compound annual growth rate (CAGR). This growth trajectory positions SpaceX favorably in the fast-evolving AI market.
Unmatched Scale and Technological Advantage in Space

: SpaceX's space business operates at an unparalleled scale and is years ahead of competitors, maintaining a significant technology gap. The anticipated reusability of the Starship further enhances its operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness, supporting a robust valuation in the space sector.
